predecessors.name: Yue (state)
predecessors.text: Fujian: 'the royal family of Yuè fled to Fujian after its kingdom was annexed by the State of Chu in 306 BC' (History of Fujian); the Minyue page says the family 'fled after being defeated by Chu and…

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: Wuzhu's kingdom without Dong'ou (Wenzhou and Taizhou), which Emperor Gaozu gave to Zou Yao in 192.

ledger.x: 306: the Minyue kingdom of the Yue refugees is founded in Fujian.
192: Emperor Gaozu gives the Dong'ou part of the kingdom to Zou Yao.
138: a Han fleet from Kuaiji makes Minyue withdraw.
135: the invasion ends in a murder and a peace.
135: the Han divide the kingdom between two kings, Minyue and Dongyue.
111: Han forces close in on Minyue.
110: the co-king assassinates Luo Yushan and surrenders.
110: Han takes Minyue and moves its people.

wars.name: Qin conquest of the Baiyue (Fujian campaign)
wars.outcome: Qin armies 'took the provinces of Fuzhou and Guilin'; the Minyue king was deposed and Minzhong Commandery set up (History of Fujian, undated).

wars.name: Minyue-Dong'ou war
wars.outcome: Minyue besieged Dong'ou's capital; Han relief was 'limited to troops from Kuaiji Commandery'; Dong'ou infobox 'Defeated by Minyue: 138 BC'.

wars.name: Minyue invasion of Nanyue
wars.outcome: The Minyue king was murdered by his brother Zou Yushan, who sued for peace; the Han enthroned Zou Chou and recognised Zou Yushan as king of Dongyue: a dual monarchy (135 on the infobox and the Emperor Wu page).

wars.name: Han conquest of Minyue
wars.outcome: Han forces 'approached Minyue simultaneously from four directions via land and sea in 111 BC'; Zou Yushan was murdered, the rulers surrendered, Han annexed Minyue and Dongyue (110 on the Minyue infobox and the Emperor Wu page) and moved the people to the…
